call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth target: double-digit; EBITDA margins expected to be similar or better than Q1 if growth sustains

Geopolitical developments in West Asia keeping energy, freight and trade volatility high

timeline.summary: S H Kelkar and Company Limited’s **Deepti Chandratre** (Global Legal Counsel & Company Secretary) scheduled a virtual **Q4 & FY26 results conference call** for **May 18, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST** per SEBI Listing Regulations.
SH Kelkar conducted Q1FY27 earnings conference call on July 29, 2026, reporting 14% YoY revenue growth to ₹662 Cr and 21% YoY EBITDA growth to ₹89 Cr.
S H Kelkar received cautionary letters from BSE and NSE on October 27, 2026, regarding a procedural delay in submitting an investor meet intimation from March 2025.
